BigWave Radio VERSION - Windows x64
==============================================================
MIT - https://github.com/postmanpat-303/BigWaveRadio
Licence: LICENSE.txt (MIT). Third-party notices: THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt

Created by Derek Heasley. If you find this app useful you can buy me a coffee:
https://buymeacoffee.com/postmanpat  (or PayPal: https://paypal.me/derekh100)
Thank you. :)

Run: double-click BigWaveRadio.exe (it needs no other files).
Windows SmartScreen may warn because the exe is not code-signed:
"More info" -> "Run anyway".

BigWave Radio streams live stations from the community-powered
radio-browser.info directory.
  Discover            trending, popular and recently added stations
  Search / top bar    live search with history
  Moods               Dance, Trance, Chill, Easy, 80s, 90s and Your Stars
  Star ratings        rate stations 1-5, "More like this", "Surprise me"
  Plugins             Visions, Strobe and more; community hub:
                      https://github.com/postmanpat-303/BigWaveRadio-Plugins
  Ctrl+Alt+B          show / hide the window (it lives in the tray)
  Check for updates   on the About page; a quiet daily check runs at startup
                      (Settings > Behaviour). Nothing is installed automatically.

Your library, ratings and settings are stored in
%LOCALAPPDATA%\BigWaveRadio\ and are kept when you uninstall or upgrade.

Upgrading from 0.9.3 or older: the setup removes the old per-user install
(%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\BigWaveRadio) and its shortcuts for you.
If Windows still shows the old icon, sign out and back in, or run
  ie4uinit.exe -show
